verdict.rationale: Docusign publishes a REST eSignature API, OpenAPI/Swagger specs, a full developer center, and official SDKs (e.g. Node.js client) enabling programmatic control, and community reports confirm the API is usable and 'sufficient for 95% of use cases' despite some documentation complaints. Missing for 10: standardized openapi.json/llms.txt discovery at expected paths (404s in probes) and more consistent independent praise for documentation quality.
